/**
 * Connect Hub — server side
 * © 2026 Ramy Sakr. All rights reserved.
 *
 * One Apps Script web app. Each trainee has their own link with a token in it, so they
 * click and are already themselves — no name to pick, no code to type, no login. The
 * server resolves the token to one person and will not return anybody else's work.
 *
 * SETUP (once)
 *   1. script.google.com → New project. Paste this into Code.gs.
 *   2. File → + → HTML, four times, named exactly:  Index  Plan  Self  Feedback
 *      (Apps Script adds .html itself.) Paste the matching file into each.
 *   3. Run setup() from the editor. Grant the permissions it asks for.
 *      The log gives you the spreadsheet URL and your tutor key.
 *   4. Deploy → New deployment → Web app
 *          Execute as: Me
 *          Who has access: Anyone            ← tokens do the identifying, not Google
 *      Copy the /exec URL.
 *   5. Open  <exec URL>?tutor=YOUR_KEY  → the Roster tab generates one link per trainee.
 *      Send each trainee their own link. That is the last piece of admin.
 *
 * WHAT IS ENFORCED, not merely requested
 *   · A trainee's token only ever reaches their own rows.
 *   · Feedback is deleted from the response until you release it, so it cannot be read
 *     early even by someone watching the network traffic.
 *   · A resubmitted plan cannot wipe a self-evaluation or feedback already written.
 *   · Writes are serialised, so two people submitting at once cannot clobber each other.
 */

const SHEET_TAB = 'submissions';
const ROSTER_TAB = 'roster';
const TUTORS_TAB = 'tutors';
/**
 * A Google Sheets cell holds at most 50,000 characters, and a fully written-up teaching
 * practice — long procedure column, a six-block language analysis, self-evaluation and
 * tutor feedback — measures past that. I measured it rather than assuming: a typical
 * record is about 25,000 characters and a thorough one 40,000, but a genuinely wordy
 * trainee reaches 60,000 and a maximal one 105,000. So the record is split across four
 * columns of 45,000, giving 180,000 characters of room.
 *
 * Records written before this change sit entirely in the first doc column; joining the
 * four columns returns exactly the same string, so nothing needs migrating.
 */
const DOC_COLS = 4;
const CELL_MAX = 45000;
const HEADERS = ['id', 'token', 'trainee', 'tp', 'updated', 'released',
                 'doc', 'doc2', 'doc3', 'doc4'];
const DOC_START = 7;                     /* 1-based column of the first doc cell */
const ROSTER_HEADERS = ['token', 'trainee', 'added'];
const TUTOR_HEADERS = ['key', 'tutor', 'added'];
const P = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

/** Split a serialised record into the doc columns. Throws only if it will not fit at all. */
function splitDoc_(json) {
  const s = json == null ? '' : String(json);
  if (s.length > CELL_MAX * DOC_COLS) {
    throw new Error('This record is too long to store (' + s.length.toLocaleString() +
      ' characters). Shorten the procedure column or the language analysis and save again — ' +
      'nothing has been lost, your form still holds everything.');
  }
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < DOC_COLS; i++) out.push(s.substr(i * CELL_MAX, CELL_MAX));
  return out;
}

/** Join the doc columns back into one string. Blank tail cells contribute nothing. */
function joinDoc_(row) {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < DOC_COLS; i++) {
    const cell = row[DOC_START - 1 + i];
    if (cell) s += String(cell);
  }
  return s;
}

/* ================================================================ setup */

function setup() {
  let ss;
  const existing = P.getProperty('SHEET_ID');
  if (existing) {
    ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(existing);
  } else {
    ss = SpreadsheetApp.create('Connect Hub — submissions');
    P.setProperty('SHEET_ID', ss.getId());
  }
  tab_(ss, SHEET_TAB, HEADERS);
  tab_(ss, ROSTER_TAB, ROSTER_HEADERS);
  tab_(ss, TUTORS_TAB, TUTOR_HEADERS);
  widenDocColumns_(ss.getSheetByName(SHEET_TAB));
  const blank = ss.getSheetByName('Sheet1');
  if (blank) ss.deleteSheet(blank);

  if (!P.getProperty('TUTOR_KEY')) P.setProperty('TUTOR_KEY', token_() + token_());

  /* The original single key becomes the first tutor row, so an existing deployment keeps
     working and the link already in Ramy's bookmarks does not die. */
  const tsh = ss.getSheetByName(TUTORS_TAB);
  if (tsh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    tsh.appendRow([P.getProperty('TUTOR_KEY'), 'Course tutor', new Date()]);
  }
  ensureBackupTrigger_();

  Logger.log('Spreadsheet : ' + ss.getUrl());
  Logger.log('Tutor key   : ' + P.getProperty('TUTOR_KEY'));
  Logger.log('Next: deploy as a web app, then open <exec URL>?tutor=' + P.getProperty('TUTOR_KEY'));
  return 'Done — see the log above.';
}

/**
 * An existing submissions sheet has one doc column. Add the missing three, without
 * touching a single row of data. Safe to run repeatedly.
 */
function widenDocColumns_(sh) {
  if (!sh) return;
  const have = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (have < HEADERS.length) sh.insertColumnsAfter(have, HEADERS.length - have);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, HEADERS.length).setValues([HEADERS]);
}

function tab_(ss, name, headers) {
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = ss.insertSheet(name);
    sh.appendRow(headers);
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  }
  return sh;
}

/** short, unguessable, and readable enough to paste into an email */
function token_() {
  return Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 10);
}

/* ================================================================ routing */

function doGet(e) {
  const p = (e && e.parameter) || {};
  const me = p.tutor ? whichTutor_(p.tutor) : null;
  const isTutor = !!me;
  const who = p.t ? whoIs_(p.t) : null;

  let file = 'Index';
  if (p.page === 'plan') file = 'Plan';
  else if (p.page === 'self') file = 'Self';
  else if (p.page === 'feedback') file = 'Feedback';

  /* the tutor's form and the roster are only ever served to someone holding the key */
  if (file === 'Feedback' && !isTutor) return page_('Index', false, null, '', 'That form is not yours.', '', '', '');
  /* a trainee form without a valid token has nothing to show */
  if ((file === 'Plan' || file === 'Self') && !who && !isTutor) {
    return page_('Index', false, null, '', 'That link is not valid. Ask your tutor to resend it.', '', '', '');
  }
  return page_(file, isTutor, who, p.id || '', '', me ? me.tutor : '', p.tutor || '', p.tp || '');
}

function page_(file, isTutor, who, id, notice, tutorName, rawKey, tp) {
  const t = HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile(file);
  t.isTutor = isTutor;
  t.tutorKey = isTutor ? rawKey : '';
  t.tutorName = tutorName || '';
  t.token = who ? who.token : '';
  t.trainee = who ? who.trainee : '';
  t.recordId = id;
  t.tp = tp || '';
  t.notice = notice;
  t.baseUrl = ScriptApp.getService().getUrl();
  return t.evaluate()
    .setTitle('Connect Hub')
    .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1')
    .setXFrameOptionsMode(HtmlService.XFrameOptionsMode.ALLOWALL);
}

function include(name) {
  return HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile(name).getContent();
}

/* ================================================================ helpers */

function ss_() {
  const id = P.getProperty('SHEET_ID');
  if (!id) throw new Error('Run setup() first.');
  return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
}

function sheet_() { return ss_().getSheetByName(SHEET_TAB); }
function rosterSheet_() { return ss_().getSheetByName(ROSTER_TAB); }

function roster_() {
  const sh = rosterSheet_();
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  if (last < 2) return [];
  return sh.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, ROSTER_HEADERS.length).getValues()
    .filter(r => r[0])
    .map((r, i) => ({ row: i + 2, token: String(r[0]), trainee: String(r[1]), added: r[2] }));
}

/** the whole identity model in four lines */
function whoIs_(token) {
  if (!token) return null;
  const all = roster_();
  for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) if (all[i].token === String(token)) return all[i];
  return null;
}

function requireTrainee_(token) {
  const who = whoIs_(token);
  if (!who) throw new Error('That link is not valid.');
  return who;
}

function tutorsSheet_() { return ss_().getSheetByName(TUTORS_TAB); }

function tutors_() {
  const sh = tutorsSheet_();
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  if (last < 2) return [];
  return sh.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, TUTOR_HEADERS.length).getValues()
    .filter(r => r[0])
    .map((r, i) => ({ row: i + 2, key: String(r[0]), tutor: String(r[1]), added: r[2] }));
}

/** Any key on the tutors sheet is valid. Returns who it belongs to. */
function whichTutor_(key) {
  if (!key) return null;
  const all = tutors_();
  for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) if (all[i].key === String(key)) return all[i];
  /* fall back to the original property key, for a deployment set up before tutors existed */
  if (String(key) === P.getProperty('TUTOR_KEY')) return { row: 0, key: String(key), tutor: 'Course tutor' };
  return null;
}

function requireTutor_(key) {
  const who = whichTutor_(key);
  if (!who) throw new Error('Not authorised.');
  return who;
}

function rows_() {
  const sh = sheet_();
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  if (last < 2) return [];
  /* A sheet created before the extra doc columns existed is still only seven wide, and
     asking for ten would throw. Widen it in place, so this works whether or not setup()
     has been re-run. */
  if (sh.getLastColumn() < HEADERS.length) widenDocColumns_(sh);
  return sh.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, HEADERS.length).getValues().map((r, i) => ({
    row: i + 2,
    id: String(r[0]),
    token: String(r[1]),
    trainee: String(r[2]),
    tp: String(r[3]),
    updated: r[4],
    released: r[5] === true || r[5] === 'TRUE',
    doc: docOf_(r)
  }));
}

/**
 * Parse the record, and survive a corrupt one. A throw here used to take down the whole
 * list — one damaged row and neither the trainee nor the tutor could see anything at all.
 * Now the bad row reports itself and the rest of the course still loads.
 */
function docOf_(r) {
  const raw = joinDoc_(r);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (err) {
    return { broken: true, error: String(err), length: raw.length };
  }
}

function find_(id) {
  const all = rows_();
  for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) if (all[i].id === id) return all[i];
  return null;
}

function write_(rec) {
  const parts = splitDoc_(JSON.stringify(rec.doc));
  sheet_().getRange(rec.row, 1, 1, HEADERS.length).setValues([
    [rec.id, rec.token, rec.trainee, rec.tp, new Date(), rec.released].concat(parts)
  ]);
}

function stamp_(d) { return d ? new Date(d).toISOString() : ''; }

function withLock_(fn) {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(20000);
  try { return fn(); } finally { lock.releaseLock(); }
}

/* ================================================================ trainee API */
/* Every one of these takes the token and nothing else identifying. There is no call a
   trainee can make that returns another trainee's work. */

function apiMe(token) {
  const who = requireTrainee_(token);
  return { trainee: who.trainee, token: who.token };
}

function apiListMine(token) {
  const who = requireTrainee_(token);
  return rows_()
    .filter(r => r.token === who.token)
    .sort((a, b) => String(b.tp).localeCompare(String(a.tp), undefined, { numeric: true }))
    .map(r => ({
      id: r.id,
      tp: r.tp,
      updated: stamp_(r.updated),
      hasPlan: !!(r.doc && r.doc.plan),
      hasSelf: !!(r.doc && r.doc.self),
      feedbackWaiting: r.released && !!(r.doc && r.doc.feedback)
    }));
}

/**
 * One TP. The feedback is cut out of the payload unless it has been released — the
 * trainee's browser never receives it, so there is nothing to peek at.
 */
function apiLoad(token, id) {
  const rec = find_(id);
  if (!rec) throw new Error('Not found.');
  const who = requireTrainee_(token);
  if (rec.token !== who.token) throw new Error('That is not yours.');
  const doc = rec.doc || {};
  if (!rec.released) delete doc.feedback;
  return { id: rec.id, tp: rec.tp, trainee: rec.trainee, released: rec.released, doc: doc };
}

function apiSavePlan(token, tp, doc) {
  const who = requireTrainee_(token);
  /* The picker sends a valid label, but never trust the client: check it anyway. */
  const n = parseInt(P.getProperty('TP_COUNT') || '8', 10);
  const ok = /^TP([0-9]+)$/.exec(String(tp));
  if (!ok || parseInt(ok[1], 10) < 1 || parseInt(ok[1], 10) > n) {
    throw new Error('That is not one of your teaching practices.');
  }
  tp = 'TP' + parseInt(ok[1], 10);
  return withLock_(function () {
    const all = rows_();
    let rec = null;
    for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      if (all[i].token === who.token && String(all[i].tp) === String(tp)) { rec = all[i]; break; }
    }
    if (rec) {
      /* keep what the plan does not own, or resaving a plan would erase the rest of the TP */
      const keep = rec.doc || {};
      doc.self = keep.self;
      doc.feedback = keep.feedback;
      rec.doc = doc;
      write_(rec);
      return rec.id;
    }
    const id = Utilities.getUuid();
    sheet_().appendRow([id, who.token, who.trainee, tp, new Date(), false]
      .concat(splitDoc_(JSON.stringify(doc))));
    return id;
  });
}

function apiSaveSelf(token, id, self) {
  const who = requireTrainee_(token);
  return withLock_(function () {
    const rec = find_(id);
    if (!rec) throw new Error('Not found.');
    if (rec.token !== who.token) throw new Error('That is not yours.');
    rec.doc = rec.doc || {};
    rec.doc.self = self;
    write_(rec);
    return true;
  });
}

/** The starred action points from this trainee's most recent released TP. No file picking. */
function apiLastActionPoints(token) {
  const who = requireTrainee_(token);
  const done = rows_()
    .filter(r => r.token === who.token && r.released && r.doc && r.doc.feedback)
    .sort((a, b) => String(b.tp).localeCompare(String(a.tp), undefined, { numeric: true }));
  if (!done.length) return { tp: '', points: [] };
  return { tp: done[0].tp, points: done[0].doc.feedback.next || [] };
}

/* ================================================================ tutor API */

function apiListAll(key) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  return rows_().map(r => ({
    id: r.id,
    trainee: r.trainee,
    tp: r.tp,
    updated: stamp_(r.updated),
    hasPlan: !!(r.doc && r.doc.plan),
    hasSelf: !!(r.doc && r.doc.self),
    hasFeedback: !!(r.doc && r.doc.feedback),
    released: r.released
  })).sort((a, b) => String(b.updated).localeCompare(String(a.updated)));
}

function apiLoadAsTutor(key, id) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  const rec = find_(id);
  if (!rec) throw new Error('Not found.');
  return {
    id: rec.id, tp: rec.tp, trainee: rec.trainee,
    released: rec.released, doc: rec.doc || {}
  };
}

function apiSaveFeedback(key, id, feedback) {
  const me = requireTutor_(key);
  return withLock_(function () {
    const rec = find_(id);
    if (!rec) throw new Error('Not found.');
    rec.doc = rec.doc || {};
    /* stamp the author from the key, not from a field the tutor could mistype */
    feedback.tutor = feedback.tutor || me.tutor;
    feedback.writtenBy = me.tutor;
    rec.doc.feedback = feedback;
    write_(rec);
    return true;
  });
}

/** Release is the Return click: the moment the trainee can see it. */
function apiRelease(key, id, released) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  return withLock_(function () {
    const rec = find_(id);
    if (!rec) throw new Error('Not found.');
    rec.released = released !== false;
    write_(rec);
    return rec.released;
  });
}

/* ================================================================ roster API */

function apiRoster(key) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  const base = ScriptApp.getService().getUrl();
  return roster_().map(r => ({
    token: r.token, trainee: r.trainee,
    added: stamp_(r.added),
    link: base + '?t=' + r.token
  }));
}

function apiAddTrainee(key, name) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  const clean = String(name || '').trim();
  if (!clean) throw new Error('Give them a name.');
  return withLock_(function () {
    const t = token_();
    rosterSheet_().appendRow([t, clean, new Date()]);
    return { token: t, trainee: clean, link: ScriptApp.getService().getUrl() + '?t=' + t };
  });
}

/** Issues a new token for someone — their old link stops working, their work stays. */
function apiResetLink(key, oldToken) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  return withLock_(function () {
    const who = whoIs_(oldToken);
    if (!who) throw new Error('Not on the roster.');
    const t = token_();
    rosterSheet_().getRange(who.row, 1).setValue(t);
    rows_().filter(r => r.token === oldToken).forEach(function (r) {
      sheet_().getRange(r.row, 2).setValue(t);
    });
    return { token: t, trainee: who.trainee, link: ScriptApp.getService().getUrl() + '?t=' + t };
  });
}

function apiRemoveTrainee(key, token) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  return withLock_(function () {
    const who = whoIs_(token);
    if (!who) return false;
    rosterSheet_().deleteRow(who.row);
    return true;   /* their submissions stay in the sheet as the record */
  });
}

/* ================================================================ tutors */

function apiTutors(key) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  const base = ScriptApp.getService().getUrl();
  return tutors_().map(t => ({
    key: t.key, tutor: t.tutor, added: stamp_(t.added),
    link: base + '?tutor=' + t.key
  }));
}

function apiAddTutor(key, name) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  const clean = String(name || '').trim();
  if (!clean) throw new Error('Give them a name.');
  return withLock_(function () {
    const k = token_() + token_();
    tutorsSheet_().appendRow([k, clean, new Date()]);
    return { key: k, tutor: clean, link: ScriptApp.getService().getUrl() + '?tutor=' + k };
  });
}

/**
 * Removing a tutor kills their link. Feedback they already wrote keeps their name,
 * because it was stamped into the record at the time.
 * You cannot remove the last tutor, or you would lock yourself out.
 */
function apiRemoveTutor(key, targetKey) {
  requireTutor_(key);
  return withLock_(function () {
    const all = tutors_();
    if (all.length <= 1) throw new Error('That is the only tutor left — you would lock yourself out.');
    const t = all.filter(x => x.key === String(targetKey))[0];
    if (!t) throw new Error('Not on the tutors list.');
    tutorsSheet_().deleteRow(t.row);
    /* if the removed key was the original property key, retire it too */
    if (String(targetKey) === P.getProperty('TUTOR_KEY')) {
      P.setProperty('TUTOR_KEY', tutors_()[0] ? tutors_()[0].key : token_() + token_());
    }
    return true;
  });
}

/* ================================================================ TP list */

/** The TPs a trainee may start. Configurable: set TP_COUNT in Script Properties. */
function apiTpList(token) {
  const who = requireTrainee_(token);
  const n = parseInt(P.getProperty('TP_COUNT') || '8', 10);
  const taken = {};
  rows_().filter(r => r.token === who.token).forEach(r => { taken[String(r.tp)] = true; });
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    const label = 'TP' + i;
    out.push({ tp: label, taken: !!taken[label] });
  }
  return out;
}

/* ================================================================ backup */

/**
 * A dated copy of the spreadsheet, once a day. Keeps the last 30 and deletes older ones,
 * so the folder does not grow forever. Drive's own version history is the other net.
 */
function dailyBackup() {
  const file = DriveApp.getFileById(P.getProperty('SHEET_ID'));
  const stamp = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  const folder = backupFolder_();
  const name = 'Connect Hub backup ' + stamp;

  const existing = folder.getFilesByName(name);
  if (existing.hasNext()) return 'already done today';

  file.makeCopy(name, folder);

  const keep = 30;
  const all = [];
  const it = folder.getFiles();
  while (it.hasNext()) all.push(it.next());
  all.sort((a, b) => b.getDateCreated() - a.getDateCreated());
  all.slice(keep).forEach(f => f.setTrashed(true));
  return 'backed up as ' + name;
}

function backupFolder_() {
  const id = P.getProperty('BACKUP_FOLDER_ID');
  if (id) {
    try { return DriveApp.getFolderById(id); } catch (e) { /* deleted — make a new one */ }
  }
  const f = DriveApp.createFolder('Connect Hub backups');
  P.setProperty('BACKUP_FOLDER_ID', f.getId());
  return f;
}

function ensureBackupTrigger_() {
  const already = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()
    .some(t => t.getHandlerFunction() === 'dailyBackup');
  if (already) return;
  ScriptApp.newTrigger('dailyBackup').timeBased().everyDays(1).atHour(2).create();
}

/* ================================================================ pages */

/* ---- Index ---- */
const PAGE_INDEX_ = '';

/* ---- Plan ---- */
const PAGE_PLAN_ = '';

/* ---- Self ---- */
const PAGE_SELF_ = '';

/* ---- Feedback ---- */
const PAGE_FEEDBACK_ = '';

const PAGES_ = {
  Index: PAGE_INDEX_,
  Plan: PAGE_PLAN_,
  Self: PAGE_SELF_,
  Feedback: PAGE_FEEDBACK_
};
